source_of_truth: server/scripts/reconcileCoaches.js (reconcile() + outreach eligibility block). Gates read from code, not inferred.
final_eligibility_expression: eligible = inst===RESOLVED && emailStatus==='verified' && hasRealEmail && !isTeam && classification IN (KEEP,REASSIGN) && corroborated && !provenStale   [reconcileCoaches.js ~L119-120]

gates.input: email_source_url domain (sdom) + athletics_domains status/unitid; else email domain (edom) VERIFIED; else coach_seasons identity at current school
gates.pass: sdom VERIFIED/VERIFIED_ALIAS -> evUnitid (SOURCE_DOMAIN); OR edom VERIFIED -> evUnitid (EMAIL_DOMAIN); OR idAtCurrent -> RESOLVED via COACH_SEASONS
gates.fail: sdom WRONG_INSTITUTION/AMBIGUOUS -> REVIEW; no VERIFIED domain and no coach_seasons identity -> WITHHOLD
REVIEW (domain says elsewhere) or WITHHOLD (no evidence)

gates.input: coach_seasons (csBySchool identities; csTrustedDomains = registrable domains coach_seasons scraped)
gates.pass: idAtCurrent (coach name in coach_seasons at current school) OR idAtEvidence (coach name in coach_seasons at evidence school) OR sourceDomainTrusted (email_source_url registrable domain is in csTrustedDomains AND that domain is VERIFIED/VERIFIED_ALIAS AND its unitid === resolvedUnitid)
gates.fail: coach_seasons has neither the identity nor a scraped source domain resolving to the same unitid
gates.recoverable: ONLY by adding coach_seasons evidence (scrape) or the coach identity; NOT by domain verification alone
gates.note: THIS is the structural NAIA blocker: a VERIFIED domain + authoritative exact email is NOT sufficient without a coach_seasons scrape of that domain (or the coach name in coach_seasons).

sport_scope_note: Institution resolution is sport-scoped: uni(name,sport) and coach_seasons keys are (school,sport). A cross-sport mismatch fails resolution/corroboration for that programme, not a separate gate.
wrong_institution_protection: sdom WRONG_INSTITUTION/AMBIGUOUS forces REVIEW and resolvedUnitid=null (L83-84,95-96); sourceDomainTrusted additionally requires the trusted domain's unitid === resolvedUnitid (L114), blocking the Columbia-College->Columbia-University class of false positive.
